title: Four ancient vases seized in Athens home

title: The South Indian Food Revolution: How Sambar Ritual is Leading an Ancient Cuisine's Conquest of Modern India
description: New Delhi [India], July 2: From the rich culinary traditions of South India to the vibrant food culture of North India, authentic regional flavours are finding a new generation of admirers. As diners increasingly seek cuisine rooted in heritage, quality, and authenticity, South Indian food is experiencing a remarkable revival. Among the brands leading this transformation is Sambar Ritual, bringing the timeless taste of traditional South Indian kitchens to modern dining experiences.

title: Why Ancient Millets Are Making a Global Comeback in Modern Diets
description: Ancient millets are making a significant comeback, reclaiming their place as nutritional powerhouses and sustainable food sources. Once a staple, these hardy grains, including ragi and pearl millet, offer complex carbohydrates, essential minerals, and high fiber, supporting health and digestion. Their resilience in challenging climates and low water needs make them ideal for modern agriculture, while their versatility allows easy integration into everyday meals, from porridges to breads.
